2608.07914.title: When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits
2608.07914.paper_summary: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. Frozen calibration efficacy predicts held-out power curves, with R^2 = 0.83-0.98 across six exact-permutation channels, but the efficacy-only Gaussian budget is miscalibrated at the small sample sizes it prescribes, failing in 9/9 gate-passing channels even though efficacy itself transports. The failure is in the inversion, not the calibration. A predeclared two-stage planner that simulates the deployed test repairs the budgets, is uniformly conservative, and abstains when its probe does not transport. The certificate is valid but vacuous at audit scale, and a five-seed paired injection study recovers the mechanism ordering verbatim > paraphrase > surface, in which the apparent answer-only signal is explained by baseline drift. We report the audit contract and its failures together: a non-rejection is interpretable only alongside the efficacy, budget, and validity gates that produced it.
2608.07914.paper_summary_zh: 行為污染檢測器可能返回「沒有證據」，這可能是因為基準是乾淨的，或者因為審計的能力較弱。我們為一個基準形式化這一區別，其中在訓練期間看到的項目佔未知比例 alpha。對於匹配的乾淨和已見對照，行為通道是稀疏混合 Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1，而精確的二階矩論證表明可檢測性由 alpha * rho * sqrt(m) 控制，其中 rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) 測量行為可分離性。任何標量檢測器簡化為其效能，ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho，這可以在審計運行之前從對照中估計。單獨的樣本拆分證書在不需要方向假設的情況下下界 alpha 的分佈自由。我們的實證發現是雙向的。凍結的校準效能預測保留的能力曲線，在六個精確置換通道中 R^2 = 0.83-0.98，但僅效能的高斯預算在其所規定的小樣本大小下被錯誤校準，在 9/9 的通過門通道中失敗，即使效能本身是可傳輸的。失敗發生在反演中，而不是校準中。一個預先宣告的兩階段規劃者模擬部署的測試修復預算，始終保守，並在其探針未能傳輸時保持不作為。該證書在審計規模上是有效但空洞的，而一項五種種子配對注入研究逐字恢復機制排序 verbatim > 釋義 > 表面，其中表面上的僅答案信號由基線漂移解釋。我們一起報告審計合同及其失敗：非拒絕僅在與產生它的效能、預算和有效性閘門一起解釋時才有意義。
